list_note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official ones as published on PlayStation Network, cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles on 18 November 2026. Guides are written for this entry in our own words; each cites its sources.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Collect the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks by itself. No online trophy is required, so a single playthrough plus cleanup will do it. Expect roughly 200 hours at a 4/10 difficulty, per PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Play Gone Fishing, the first mission of Chapter 1, and it unlocks when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish Chapter 1; it unlocks as Chapter 2 opens with What's in the Bag?.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish Chapter 2; it unlocks as Chapter 3 opens with Welcome to Vice City.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish Chapter 3; it unlocks after the opening missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish Chapter 4; it unlocks after the chapter's closing mission, Starting From Zero.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish the final mission of the game. This is the only gold trophy tied to the story; the other gold is A Long Road for 100% completion.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish Breakfast Run in Chapter 2.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish Child's Play in Chapter 4.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish Headliners in Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The 100% completion trophy and the hardest one. After the story, check Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. The checklist is forgiving — roughly 60% true completion: any 100 optional missions, 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 300 stunts, plus all robberies, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Nothing here is missable, and story progress already counts.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts out of 397: 130 Stunt Jumps, 202 Under the Bridges, 40 Knife Flights, 25 Base Jumps. Under the Bridges are the fastest to clear. You need 300 for 100%, so this one unlocks along the way. Track them in Progress > Activities > Stunts; the map lists them under Exploration > Stunt Spots.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all nine activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race, and a stunt. Most will happen on their own during the story and the 100% run; check Progress > Activities for the ones left, and use the map's Activities filter (blue dumbbell) to find them.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Win gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. Only the golds matter — no other range requirement. PowerPyx lists all 12 range locations.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at each of the 14 locations (42 races total). One win per location is enough; you don't need all 42.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations, so any 20 wins count, and wins also count toward 100%.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he texts you a fishing spot (purple map marker). Follow his fishing questline and beat him in a challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one of the four arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III or Time Jackers Rewind on the TV at home from Chapter 1, or Bang For Your Buck at arcade machines around the world. Finish all levels once — you don't need to beat every challenge.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy is one of the strangers you meet around Leonida. His jobs show up as purple stranger markers once unlocked. Work through his strand and finish his final mission.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton is another stranger mission-giver. Follow his strand through to its last mission and complete it.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy is a stranger whose strand involves riding. Complete his missions through to the final one.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish any 8 stranger mission strands. Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone are five of them, and there are more strangers scattered across Leonida. You do not need every stranger in the game — just 8 complete strands.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy is a stranger mission-giver. Finish his strand's final mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone is a stranger mission-giver. Finish his strand's final mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONLY MISSABLE TROPHY. There are 18 meditation spots across Leonida, and one of them — the balcony in Chapter 1 — is only available during that part of the story. Once you move past Chapter 1, it is gone for that playthrough. Meditate on the balcony the first chance you get, then clear the other 17 spots as you explore.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret gives hunting quests. Track down the specific rare animal he asks for — a unique animal, not a regular hunt — and take it down. His quests appear as you progress; watch for his marker on the map.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Trading cards are hidden all over Leonida — in shops, on tables, out in the world. Collect the cards for any 3 complete sets. The map and a checklist help; you only need 3 sets, not every card in the game.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK is the in-game social app. Open it at landmarks around Leonida and check in — 100 check-ins in total. It is a grind, but every landmark counts, and you will pass most of them during the 100% run anyway.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Challenges are the small tasks listed under Progress > Challenges — driving, combat, exploration and more. Any 50 count, and you need 70 of 80 for 100%, so this one unlocks on the way to A Long Road.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build up a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape. Cause chaos in a quiet area until you hit four stars, then break line of sight and hide until the stars clear. Your partner must be with you when the wanted level drops.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without letting your wanted level clear between them. Plan a route with three close shops, rob each quickly, and keep moving — the stars must stay up through all three.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: New vehicles you encounter get logged. Drive around and come across 100 different vehicles — you need 200 of 277 for 100%, so this unlocks early in the cleanup.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is the slow-mo aiming mode. Wait until five enemies are grouped together, trigger it, and drop all five before it ends. A busy shootout with enemies clustered together is the best chance.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At VCIA, the Vice City airport, steal a plane and take off without clearance — just get a plane airborne from the airport. Any plane works; the hard part is reaching one past security.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get involved with a Rhino — the military tank. Steal or commandeer one and drive it, or survive an encounter with one. The military base is where to find them.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store clean — no alarms, no one spotting you. Plan the approach, avoid cameras and staff sightlines, take the goods and leave without being seen.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Bank vault robberies are bigger jobs. Plan each one, get in, crack the vault, and escape the wanted level. Five successful vault jobs in total.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Armored trucks drive set routes around the city. Intercept one, stop it, take the cash, and lose the wanted level. Blocking the road with a vehicle is the reliable way to stop one.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Visit every named area in Leonida — all 52 districts, towns and regions across the state. The map tracks which areas you have been to; check Progress > Exploration for the gaps and mop them up.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Every gang runs illegal operations — drug labs, chop shops and the like. Hit one operation per gang: nine robberies in total, one for each of the nine gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Head to a bar or cafe on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and enjoy the view. A small moment trophy — do it when you are in the area in Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car through a vehicle showroom's front window and out the other side. Pick a showroom, build up speed, and crash straight through it.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Find the Kolt & Associates bowling alley, rent a lane, and bowl a frame. Any score counts — just finish a game.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Build your partnership's following. Post with your partner on the in-game social apps and grow the audience — this one tracks your shared social presence.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices throughout the game — dialogue options, side decisions, story forks. The count tracks up to 500 choices across a playthrough, so keep choosing and it will come.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: At launch, no reliable method for this trophy has been confirmed — the description hints at succeeding on a second attempt at something. We are tracking community reports and will update this guide when a method is verified. Do not chase this one yet.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Something strange — an unexplained event out in the world. Keep an eye out for odd occurrences while exploring; community reports point to a specific weird encounter. Details are still being verified.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: At launch, no reliable method for this trophy has been confirmed — the description suggests knocking someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. We are tracking community reports and will update this guide when a method is verified.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked bills come from robberies. Launder them through your contacts — the laundering option in the contacts menu. $250,000 total laundered.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops — clothes, food, weapons, cars, anything. Big purchases like cars speed it up; it will also grow naturally over a full playthrough.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy every garage property in Leonida — there are 8 of them. They also give you storage for your vehicles, so they are worth owning anyway.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app lets you register vehicles you own or find. Register 10 different vehicles through the app.
